comment: Independent C-first dwarvish Archeologist with DECgraphics and msg_window:single. ';' farlooks the floor south of the hero; pager.c's putmixed() line opens with the room glyph's showsyms byte 0xFE, which topl.c redotoplin() first prints through g_putch() under ttyDisplay->mixed. After the --More-- is dismissed, Ctrl-P (step 9) redraws the line with mixed clear, so topl_putsym(char) prints 0xFE and recorder patch 006's nomux_putch() ignores it: column 0 keeps the blank the dismissal left.
